input: What is the latest on TSMC's Arizona fab timeline: which fabs are producing, and what has been delayed or pulled forward?

output.question: What is the latest on TSMC's Arizona fab timeline: which fabs are producing, and what has been delayed or pulled forward?
output.answer: TSMC's first Arizona fab is the only one in volume production. It has run since 2024 on 4nm and in October 2025 started volume production of Nvidia Blackwell wafers. On its October 15, 2026 earnings call, TSMC said the second fab (3nm) is built and tools are being moved in and installed, with volume production now set for 3Q 2027, which C.C. Wei called 'slightly ahead of our previous schedule.' That fab was once slated for 2028 and the guidance has moved earlier more than once. The third fab (2nm/A16) is still under construction, with production targeted before the end of the decade. Early construction has started on a fourth fab and the first Arizona advanced packaging facility. Current guidance shows no new delays. TSMC is also looking at expansion outside Arizona, with teams evaluating Texas and talks with a customer about Terafab capacity, but nothing is decided.

key_facts.fact: Fab 2 construction is complete and tools are being moved in and installed. Volume production will begin in 3Q 2027, 'slightly ahead of our previous schedule' (C.C. Wei, Q3 2026 call).
Fab 1 has been running since 2024 on 4nm. Fab 2 will make 3nm chips. Fab 3 (2nm) is still under construction. Early construction has started on Fab 4 and the first advanced packaging facility.
Fab 3 targets 2nm and full operation before the end of the decade. Total Arizona investment is $265 billion. TSMC is evaluating Texas with no decision yet.
TSMC sent teams to evaluate Texas and is talking with a customer about using its Terafab capacity. Any such fab would have to be run by TSMC. Talks are ongoing.

Pull-in history: Fab 2 was earlier slated for 2028. A December 2025 report (via Nikkei) said tool install would come in 3Q26 and 3nm production in 2027. In January 2026 TSMC guided to high-volume production in 2H 2027.
In October 2025, TSMC Arizona started volume production of Nvidia Blackwell GPUs on N4P.

caveats: Wei called 3Q27 'slightly ahead of our previous schedule.' Earlier guidance said 2H27, so the latest pull-in is small, and this round's previous target was not stated precisely.

TSMC has not given a firm date for Fab 3 beyond 'before the end of the decade' (2nm/A16). A September 2025 press report (Economic Daily News via TrendForce) that it could be pulled into 2027 has not been confirmed by TSMC.
There are no public dates for Fab 4 or the Arizona advanced packaging plant. Reports of up to 12 Arizona fabs come from unconfirmed insider sources (Digitimes, January 2026).
Texas and Terafab capacity are only under discussion, with no commitment.
The Blackwell/N4P and 2H27 facts come from search-result summaries of Manufacturing Dive and TrendForce, not from pages I opened myself.
